record.paper_title: Open problems in the Kontsevich graph construction of Poisson bracket symmetries
record.context_brief: Graph symmetries in the Poisson sigma-model
record.original_question: How do graph-complex symmetries Ṗ=O→r(γ)(P) act on the Ikeda–Izawa Poisson σ-model, whose Feynman path-integral expansion encodes the Kontsevich star-product? In addition, does that σ-model possess symmetries that do not originate from graph cocycles γ in ker d?

evidence.quote: Problem 18. How does the graph complex act – by the symmetries P˙ = O→r(γ)(P) – on the Ikeda–Izawa Poisson σ-model [13] in which the Feynman path integral expansions of correlation functions [10] encode the Kontsevich star-product ⋆ = × + ħ {·, ·}_P + o(ħ) ? • Does the σ-model in [13] have symmetries not originating from the graphs γ ∈ ker d ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $(M,P)$ be a smooth finite-dimensional Poisson manifold with Poisson bivector $P\in\Gamma(\Lambda^2 TM)$, satisfying $[\![P,P]\!]=0$ in the Schouten bracket. Recall Kontsevich's directed graph complex: a vertex set with ordered pairs of outgoing edges per internal vertex carries a differential $d$ given by vertex expansion, and any cocycle $\gamma\in\ker d$ produces, via the Kontsevich graph orientation map, a bivector-valued differential operator $\mathcal{O}_{\vec r(\gamma)}(P)\in\Gamma(\Lambda^2 TM)$ such that the flow $\dot P=\mathcal{O}_{\vec r(\gamma)}(P)$ preserves the class of Poisson bivectors (i.e.\ $[\![P,\dot P]\!]=0$ on the nose). Kontsevich's formality also produces, for each $P$, an associative star product $\star=\times+\hbar\{\cdot,\cdot\}_P+o(\hbar)$ on $C^\infty(M)[\![\hbar]\!]$.

Consider the Ikeda–Izawa Poisson sigma-model: a two-dimensional topological field theory whose fields are a map $X:\Sigma\to M$ from a disk $\Sigma$ together with a $1$-form $\eta\in\Omega^1(\Sigma,X^*T^*M)$, with action
$$S_P[X,\eta]=\int_\Sigma \big(\langle\eta,dX\rangle+\tfrac12 P^{ij}(X)\,\eta_i\wedge\eta_j\big),$$
whose perturbative Feynman path-integral expansion of boundary correlators $\langle f(X(0))\,g(X(1))\rangle$ recovers the Kontsevich star product $f\star g$.

Problem.
(a) Determine how the graph-complex symmetry flows $\dot P=\mathcal{O}_{\vec r(\gamma)}(P)$, with $\gamma\in\ker d$, act on the Ikeda–Izawa Poisson sigma-model: identify the corresponding transformations of the fields $(X,\eta)$ and/or of the action $S_P$ that implement these infinitesimal deformations of $P$ as symmetries (or quasi-symmetries) of the path-integral measure, in a way compatible with the encoding of $\star$ by boundary correlators.

(b) Decide whether the Ikeda–Izawa Poisson sigma-model admits infinitesimal symmetries deforming the Poisson structure $P$ that do not arise from any graph cocycle $\gamma\in\ker d$ via the construction $\mathcal{O}_{\vec r(\gamma)}$.

artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an explicit open problem in the list of open problems on the Kontsevich graph construction of Poisson-bracket symmetries. No subsequent published work has been located that resolves how graph-cocycle flows act on the Ikeda–Izawa Poisson sigma-model or that classifies its non-graph symmetries; thus the problem appears to remain open.
